lesson: Small paste scale (0.3-0.7) is the dominant lever: best mAP50 (0.604) and best patches AP50 (0.79), confirming the small-miss hypothesis. Balanced allocation beat inclusion-heavy, and any_class backgrounds badly hurt inclusion (0.21) — keep same_class + balanced + small scale. Next round: build on small scale and probe whether going even smaller (0.3-0.5) or prefer_small sources recovers the still-missed smallest instances, while keeping same_class pool.
